component.name: triib
component.summary: Discover, connect and set up AVB and Milan devices

description.p: triib is a lightweight ATDECC (IEEE 1722.1) controller with Milan and AVB Lite support. It finds the AVB devices on a network, reads what they offer and lets you connect and set them up.

ul.li: Connect talkers and listeners in a matrix, and save and recall presets
See the network as the devices' gPTP paths show it, with each stream's way through it
Change names, stream formats, sampling rates, clock sources, channel mappings and controls
Follow AVB Lite devices, their streams and the alarms the profile calls for
Log every ATDECC frame sent and heard, marking those that break the rules

description.p: Sending and receiving raw Ethernet needs the CAP_NET_RAW capability, which the package sets.

The first release: discovery, a connection matrix, a map of the network and its clocks, entity settings, presets, a frame log and AVB Lite status on Linux, Windows and macOS, and on Linux talkers and listeners of the computer's own, on AVB and AVB Lite networks.
